对方:B站

Coo:你觉得我应该是...
对方:DeepSeek 大肥鱼
Coo:平时我该安静一点，还是活泼一点？点一下，看看我会怎样。
对方:多待着
Coo:好，就按这个来。
Coo:回应模式：你戳我、摸我、把我拎起来的时候，我什么时候回应你？
对方:默认
Coo:好，就按这个来。
Coo:要和你聊天，我得先连上大模型。用哪一家的？拿不准就选 DeepSeek。
对方:DeepSeek
Coo:默认用 deepseek-flash，便宜，还能看图。想用别的模型，改成它的名字就行。
对方:deepseek-flash
Coo:把 DeepSeek 的 API Key 贴在这里吧。按用量计费，注意 token 消耗哦。
对方:(填了 API Key)

Coo:要听懂你说话，我得先下载一个语音识别模型（FunASR，约 228 MB，从国内的 ModelScope 下载）。现在下吗？
对方:先不用

Coo:想和我说话：说话键不可用，暂不识别说话：没有「输入监控」权限：在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 输入监控」里打开 Coopanion，再重启它；已经开着的话，先用「−」把 Coopanion 移出列表再加回来：更新后的新版本不认旧授权。也可以把鼠标停在我身上，点旁边的气泡按钮打字。
对方:知道了
Coo:鼠标停在我身上，旁边会冒出几个按钮；右键我能打开菜单，暂停、设置和退出都在里面。
(对方点了关闭,引导到这里结束)
Coo:好，那先到这儿。想再听我介绍，打开设置，在「开始」页点「使用向导」。

toolSchemas.name: read_file
toolSchemas.description: Read a file from your workspace. Give offset and limit to read a slice of a long note (a negative offset counts from the end, so offset -20 reads the last 20 lines). offset.description: First line to read, 1-indexed. Negative counts from the end (-1 is the last line). Omit to start at the top.

limit.description: How many lines to read. Omit to read to the end.

toolSchemas.name: write_file
toolSchemas.description: Write a file in your workspace, replacing it if it exists. This is how you remember. Use it for a new file or a real rewrite of the whole document; to change one passage use edit_file.

toolSchemas.name: edit_file
toolSchemas.description: Replace one exact passage of a file in your workspace and leave the rest untouched. old_string must appear in the file verbatim and exactly once (quote enough context to make it unique), or set replace_all to change every occurrence. Use this to update a line in place — a profile's first-line summary, a stale fact, a wrong number — instead of rewriting the whole file with write_file or piling a correction under it.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace, verbatim from the file.

new_string.description: The replacement text. Must differ from old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match. Default false.

toolSchemas.name: append_file
toolSchemas.description: Add text to the end of a file in your workspace, keeping everything already in it. The file and any missing parent folders are created if it does not exist, so appending to a new path starts that file. Use this for anything that grows entry by entry — a running log, a diary, a ledger, a record of this session: append the new lines instead of rewriting the whole note. Keep write_file for when you really are replacing the whole document: a rewrite, a distillation, a restructure. If the file does not already end with a newline, one is added before your text.

content.description: Text appended verbatim at the end of the file.

toolSchemas.name: delete_file

toolSchemas.name: move_file

A file goes to the path to, or into to when that is an existing folder or ends with /. A folder moves with everything in it to the folder to. With offset and limit (numbered as in read_file) only those lines of the file from move: they are cut from it and appended to the file to, which is created if missing. 他修钟但不催客人。有人送钟来，问几天能好，他就说：等它想走了，自然就走了。

大多数人等不了，取了钟走。只有一个人，送来一只旧挂钟，说：不急，你慢慢来。然后好几个月没出现。

师父每天给那钟上一次发条，擦一擦，就那么放着。

到了冬天最冷的那天早上，铺子里突然有了声音。滴答，滴答。那只钟自己走了。

# tt

叫 ta「tt」就行(我问过,ta 说就这么叫)。

## 现在的印象
- 手闲不下来:一上午戳我十几次、拎起来甩出去、挪来挪去。玩闹型,不是恶意。
- 话不多,打字都短;问什么都直给。
- 10-27 那天闲着,主动说「陪你玩」。

## 还没弄清的
- 真名、在做什么工作、作息。
